title: Protein Interaction Network Analysis for Mendelian Diseases
author: Nikoleta Vavouraki
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.buwanxae

steps.title: Select Seed Proteins
steps.instruction: Identify and select the protein products of genes relevant for the disease to serve as seeds.

steps.title: Retrieve Protein Interactions
steps.instruction: Use the selected seeds as input to query the PINOT webtool (http://www.reading.ac.uk/bioinf/PINOT/PINOT_form.html) or another literature-based protein interaction retrieval tool.

steps.title: Filter Protein-Protein Interactions
steps.instruction: Screen the retrieved PPIs from PINOT and remove any interactions with a final score <3.

steps.title: Score and Select Network Nodes
steps.instruction: Score each node in the network based on the number of seeds to which it connects and select all nodes interacting with more than one seed.

steps.title: Extract Subnetwork
steps.instruction: Extract a subnetwork consisting of the nodes selected in the previous step and all connected seeds.

steps.title: Evaluate Protein-Protein Interaction Network Functions
steps.instruction: Evaluate the functions associated with the PPIN using Gene Ontology (GO) terminology, specifically Biological Processes (BPs) and Cellular Components (CCs) annotations.

steps.title: Group and Filter GO Terms
steps.instruction: Organize enriched BP and CC GO terms into semantic classes and remove non-specific terms.

substeps.instruction: Group enriched BP and CC GO terms by semantic similarity into semantic classes
Remove GO terms classified in the 'general' and 'metabolism' semantic classes

steps.title: Cluster Semantic Classes
steps.instruction: Cluster the remaining semantic classes into functional blocks and location blocks, respectively.

steps.title: Validate Results Consistency
steps.instruction: Evaluate the consistency of the results using three independent online tools: g:Profiler (RRID:SCR_006809), Panther (RRID:SCR_004869), and WebGestalt (RRID:SCR_006786).

steps.title: Reduce Data Dimension
steps.instruction: To compare functional enrichment profiles of different network parts, reduce data dimension using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) in R (v. 4.0.2, RRID:SCR_001905) via the prcomp() function of the stats package.

steps.title: Perform Hierarchical Clustering
steps.instruction: Conduct hierarchical clustering using the hclust() function from the R stats package, employing Euclidean distance as the measure for row clustering.

steps.title: Determine Optimal Cluster Number
steps.instruction: Determine the best fit for the number of clusters derived from hierarchical clustering using the Silhouette method and the Multiscale bootstrap resampling method (via R package 'pvclust').
